28 class PolicyUnavailable(RuntimeError):
29     def __init__(self, family, reason, *, code="capability_unavailable"):
30         self.family, self.code = family, code
31         super().__init__(f"{family}: {reason}")

34 def validate_policy(value):
35     if not isinstance(value, dict) or value != DEFAULT_POLICY:
36         raise ValueError("model_policy must select latest_supported / highest_supported")
37     return dict(DEFAULT_POLICY)

40 def highest_effort(levels):
41     """Reject unknown semantics instead of silently choosing a lower effort."""
42     values = []
43     if not isinstance(levels, list):
44         raise ValueError("No supported, understood reasoning-effort ordering")
45     for level in levels:
46         if not isinstance(level, (str, dict)):
47             raise ValueError("Invalid reasoning-effort metadata")
48         value = level if isinstance(level, str) else (
49             level.get("effort") or level.get("reasoningEffort")
50             or level.get("value") or level.get("id"))
51         if value:
52             values.append(str(value).lower())
53     if not values or any(value not in EFFORT_ORDER for value in values):
54         raise ValueError("No supported, understood reasoning-effort ordering")
55     return max(values, key=EFFORT_ORDER.index)

58 def normalize_catalog(family, raw):
59     """Keep capability fields only; never persist prompts, headers or secrets."""
60     rows = []
61     if not isinstance(raw, dict):
62         raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "invalid capability catalog")
63     def hidden(entry):
64         return (entry.get("hidden") is True or entry.get("isHidden") is True
65                 or entry.get("selectable") is False
66                 or entry.get("visibility") in ("hide", "hidden", "none"))
67     def row(model, levels, rank, upgrade, evidence):
68         if not isinstance(model, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{0,199}", model):
69             raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "catalog model identity has unsupported characters")
70         if type(rank) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(rank):
71             raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "invalid catalog priority")
72         try:
73             highest_effort(levels)
74         except ValueError as exc:
75             raise PolicyUnavailable(family, str(exc), code="unsupported_effort") from exc
76         rows.append({"model": model, "efforts": levels, "rank": rank,
77                      "upgrade": upgrade, "evidence": evidence})
78     if family == "chatgpt":
79         entries = raw.get("models", raw.get("data", []))
80         if not isinstance(entries, list):
81             raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "invalid capability catalog")
82         explicit_priority = bool(entries) and all(isinstance(e, dict) and type(e.get("priority")) in (int, float) for e in entries)
83         for index, entry in enumerate(entries):
84             if not isinstance(entry, dict):
85                 raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "invalid model metadata")
86             model = entry.get("slug") or entry.get("model") or entry.get("id")
87             if hidden(entry):
88                 continue
89             levels = entry.get("supported_reasoning_levels", entry.get("supportedReasoningEfforts", []))
90             row(model, levels, entry["priority"] if explicit_priority else index,
91                 entry.get("upgrade"), "installed_cli_priority+native_capabilities" if entry.get("_codex_catalog_evidence")
92                 else "provider_priority" if explicit_priority else "provider_catalog_order")
93     elif family == "grok":
94         entries = raw.get("models", {})
95         if isinstance(entries, dict):
96             entries = list(entries.values())
97         if not isinstance(entries, list):
98             raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "invalid capability catalog")
99         for index, entry in enumerate(entries):
100             if not isinstance(entry, dict):
101                 raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "invalid model metadata")
102             info = entry.get("info", entry)
103             if not isinstance(info, dict):
104                 raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "invalid model metadata")
105             model = info.get("model") or info.get("id")
106             if hidden(info):
107                 continue
108             row(model, info.get("reasoning_efforts", []), index, None, "provider_catalog_order")
109     elif family == "claude":
110         # `best` is the provider's moving frontier alias, not a product-name pin.
111         rows.append({"model": "best", "efforts": raw.get("efforts", []), "rank": 0,
112                      "upgrade": None, "evidence": "provider_moving_alias"})
113     else:
114         raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "the installed transport does not expose verified model capabilities")
115     if not rows:
116         raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "no visible subscription models were advertised")
117     return rows

120 def select_model(family, catalog):
121     if family not in FAMILIES:
122         raise PolicyUnavailable(str(family), "unknown model family")
123     rows = sorted(catalog, key=lambda item: item["rank"])
124     if not rows:
125         raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "no available model")
126     if family == "chatgpt" and len(rows) > 1 and rows[0]["rank"] == rows[1]["rank"]:
127         raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "latest model ranking is ambiguous; refresh subscription capabilities")
128     chosen = rows[0]
129     initial_model = chosen["model"]
130     initial_evidence = chosen["evidence"]
131     by_name = {row["model"]: row for row in rows}
132     visited = set()
133     while chosen.get("upgrade"):
134         target = chosen["upgrade"]
135         if isinstance(target, dict):
136             target = target.get("model") or target.get("id")
137         if target in visited:
138             raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "cyclic catalog upgrade metadata")
139         visited.add(chosen["model"])
140         if target not in by_name:
141             raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "recommended model upgrade is unavailable")
142         chosen = by_name[target]
143     try:
144         effort = highest_effort(chosen["efforts"])
145     except ValueError as error:
146         raise PolicyUnavailable(family, str(error), code="unsupported_effort") from error
147     result = {"policy_version": POLICY_VERSION, "requested_policy": dict(DEFAULT_POLICY),
148               "family": family, "model": chosen["model"], "effort": effort,
149               "selection_evidence": initial_evidence + ("+provider_upgrade" if initial_model != chosen["model"] else ""), "model_attested": False}
150     if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{0,199}", result["model"]):
151         raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "catalog model identity has unsupported characters")
152     if initial_evidence == "provider_catalog_order":
153         result["warning"] = "Provider-recommended catalog order; frontier ranking is not explicitly attested."
154     return result

157 def policy_environment(env=None):
158     """Ignore stale model-only pins; preserve credentials and permission policy."""
159     out = dict(os.environ if env is None else env)
160     for key in list(out):
161         if (key.startswith("ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_") and key.endswith("_MODEL")) or key in {
162             "ANTHROPIC_MODEL", "CLAUDE_MODEL", "CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL", "GROK_DEFAULT_MODEL",
163             "GROK_MODEL", "CODEX_MODEL", "CHATGPT_MODEL", "CODEX_REASONING_EFFORT",
164             "OPENAI_API_KEY", "CODEX_API_KEY", "XAI_API_KEY", "GROK_API_KEY",
165             "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN",
166             "OPENAI_BASE_URL", "OPENAI_API_BASE", "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL",
167             "XAI_BASE_URL", "GROK_BASE_URL", "GEMINI_API_KEY", "GOOGLE_API_KEY",
168             "CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK", "CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX", "CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY",
169         }:
170             out.pop(key, None)
171     return out

174 def _run(argv, env):
175     try:
176         completed = subprocess.run(argv, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True,
177                                    encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=25,
178                                    shell=False, creationflags=(subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if os.name == "nt" else 0))
179     except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
180         raise RuntimeError(f"CLI discovery {type(error).__name__}") from error
181     if completed.returncode:
182         # Provider stderr can contain credentials/login URLs. Never return it.
183         # Classify it instead (Grok R2 N1): only an auth-shaped failure is a
184         # dead login; any other nonzero exit is transient or unknown.
185         # URLs are stripped first: a transient body can name auth.openai.com
186         # without meaning the login is dead (Grok R3 P1); the phrases below
187         # are the adapter's own auth pattern.
188         diagnostics = re.sub(r"https?://\S+", " ", f"{completed.stderr or ''} {completed.stdout or ''}")
189         if re.search(r"(?i)(not logged in|logged out|authentication|unauthori[sz]ed|forbidden|\b401\b|\b403\b)", diagnostics):
190             raise RuntimeError(f"CLI discovery exited {completed.returncode}; subscription login required")
191         raise RuntimeError(f"CLI discovery exited {completed.returncode}; transient or unknown failure")
192     return completed.stdout

195 def discover(family, *, env=None, runner=_run):
196     env = policy_environment(env)
197     binary = {"chatgpt": "codex", "claude": "claude", "grok": "grok", "gemini": "agy"}.get(family)
198     if binary is None:
199         raise PolicyUnavailable(str(family), "unknown model family")
200     command = shutil.which(binary + (".exe" if os.name == "nt" else ""), path=env.get("PATH"))
201     if not command:
202         raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "subscription CLI is not installed", code="cli_missing")
203     try:
204         if family == "chatgpt":
205             raw = json.loads(runner([command, "debug", "models"], env))
206             # The refreshed catalog may retain bundled predecessor ranks.
207             # Reconcile only an ambiguous native top group; availability and
208             # effort remain from the refreshed subscription capabilities.
209             try:
210                 bundled = json.loads(runner([command, "debug", "models", "--bundled"], env))
211             except Exception:
212                 bundled = None  # A unique current ranking needs no tie-break.
213             raw = reconcile_codex_catalog(raw, bundled)
214         elif family == "grok":
215             version_text = runner([command, "--version"], env)
216             version_match = re.search(r"\b\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:[-+][A-Za-z0-9.]+)?\b", version_text)
217             runner([command, "models"], env)
218             grok_root = Path(env.get("GROK_HOME") or Path(env.get("USERPROFILE") or env.get("HOME") or Path.home()) / ".grok")
219             cache = json.loads((grok_root / "models_cache.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
220             from datetime import datetime, timezone
221             fetched = datetime.fromisoformat(cache["fetched_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
222             # The subscription CLI renews unchanged catalogs after an etag
223             # check without changing their original content-fetch timestamp.
224             renewed = cache.get("renewed_at")
225             fresh = (datetime.fromisoformat(renewed.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
226                      if renewed is not None else fetched)
227             if fresh < fetched:
228                 raise RuntimeError("Grok catalog renewal predates its content")
229             age = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - fresh).total_seconds()
230             if not 0 <= age < CAPABILITY_TTL_SECONDS:
231                 raise RuntimeError("Grok catalog is stale; refresh subscription capability discovery")
232             if cache.get("auth_method") != "session":
233                 raise RuntimeError("Grok capability catalog is not from subscription authentication")
234             if not version_match or cache.get("grok_version") != version_match.group(0):
235                 raise RuntimeError("Grok capability catalog belongs to another CLI version")
236             if cache.get("origin") != "https://cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1/models":
237                 raise RuntimeError("Grok capability catalog has an unverified subscription origin")
238             raw = cache
239         elif family == "claude":
240             help_text = runner([command, "--help"], env)
241             match = re.search(r"--effort\s+<[^>]+>[\s\S]{0,180}?\(([^)]+)\)", help_text)
242             if not match:
243                 raise RuntimeError("Installed Claude CLI does not advertise effort capabilities")
244             raw = {"efforts": [part.strip() for part in match.group(1).split(",")]}
245         else:
246             raise RuntimeError("agy capability discovery is not supported; configure a verified transport")
247         return normalize_catalog(family, raw), command
248     except (RuntimeError, ValueError, OSError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError) as error:
249         # codex-discipline-2026-09-15: a dead subscription login is a capacity
250         # loss (the ladder may walk), unlike a timeout or an ambiguous ranking.
251         code = "auth_required" if "subscription login required" in str(error) else "capability_unavailable"
252         raise PolicyUnavailable(family, str(error), code=code) from error

255 def _cache_identity(family, env):
256     """Invalidate on CLI/auth/config changes without reading credential values."""
257     profile = Path(env.get("USERPROFILE") or env.get("HOME") or Path.home())
258     binary = {"chatgpt": "codex", "claude": "claude", "grok": "grok", "gemini": "agy"}.get(family, "")
259     command = shutil.which(binary, path=env.get("PATH")) if binary else None
260     provider_root = Path(env.get("CODEX_HOME") or profile / ".codex") if family == "chatgpt" else (
261         Path(env.get("GROK_HOME") or profile / ".grok") if family == "grok" else Path(env.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR") or profile / ".claude"))
262     paths = ([Path(command)] if command else []) + [provider_root / name for name in
263              ("auth.json", "config.toml", "settings.json", ".credentials.json", "session.json", "models_cache.json")]
264     stamps = []
265     for path in paths:
266         try:
267             stat = path.stat()
268             stamps.append((str(path), stat.st_dev, stat.st_ino, stat.st_size, stat.st_mtime_ns))
269         except OSError:
270             stamps.append((str(path), None))
271     return (family, str(profile), env.get("PATH"), str(provider_root), tuple(stamps))

274 def resolve(family, *, settings=None, force=False, env=None, discoverer=None):
275     """Resolve for a new session/seat. This never changes an existing session."""
276     discoverer = discoverer or discover
277     if settings is not None:
278         if settings.get("settings_error"):
279             raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "Anchor settings are invalid", code="invalid_settings")
280         validate_policy(settings.get("model_policy", DEFAULT_POLICY))
281     active_env = os.environ if env is None else env
282     identity = _cache_identity(family, active_env)
283     with _LOCK:
284         cached = _MEMORY.get(identity)
285         if force or not cached or time.time() - cached["discovered_at"] >= CAPABILITY_TTL_SECONDS:
286             catalog, command = discoverer(family, env=active_env)
287             selected = select_model(family, catalog)
288             cached = {**selected, "command": command, "discovered_at": time.time()}
289             _MEMORY[_cache_identity(family, active_env)] = cached
290         result = dict(cached)
291         result["requested_policy"] = dict(DEFAULT_POLICY)
292     result["settings_revision"] = (settings or {}).get("settings_revision", 0)
293     return result

296 def cached_selection(family, *, settings=None, env=None):
297     """codex-discipline-2026-09-15 Wave 1.2: the last successful discovery for
298     ``family`` regardless of age (``stale`` says whether it is past the TTL),
299     or None when there has never been one. A pinned steward answers John from
300     this and refreshes discovery off the request thread; it never blocks a
301     send on a 25 s catalog probe."""
302     active_env = os.environ if env is None else env
303     with _LOCK:
304         cached = _MEMORY.get(_cache_identity(family, active_env))
305         if not cached:
306             return None
307         result = dict(cached)
308     result["requested_policy"] = dict(DEFAULT_POLICY)
309     result["settings_revision"] = (settings or {}).get("settings_revision", 0)
310     result["stale"] = time.time() - result.get("discovered_at", 0) >= CAPABILITY_TTL_SECONDS
311     return result

314 def launch_args(selection, *, subagents=True):
315     family, model, effort = selection["family"], selection["model"], selection["effort"]
316     if (family not in FAMILIES or not isinstance(model, str)
317             or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{0,199}", model)
318             or effort not in EFFORT_ORDER):
319         raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "invalid frozen launch selection")
320     if family == "chatgpt":
321         args = ["--model", model, "-c", f'model_reasoning_effort="{effort}"',
322                 "-c", 'forced_login_method="chatgpt"']
323         if subagents:
324             args += ["-c", f'agents.default_subagent_model="{model}"',
325                      "-c", f'agents.default_subagent_reasoning_effort="{effort}"']
326         return args
327     if family == "claude":
328         return ["--model", model, "--effort", effort]
329     if family == "grok":
330         return ["--model", model, "--reasoning-effort", effort]
331     raise PolicyUnavailable(family, "no supported highest-effort launch contract")
